correctness.rationale: Reconstructed all 1771 degree-20 joint-monomial coefficients, including 686 allowed indices after parity/distance/hull zero conditions, and rebuilt 85 valid ordinary/marginal equalities and joint 4-variable Hadamard identity. An exact Fraction verifier evaluates 74 base and 427 Hadamard multipliers and checks every allowed combined column >0 and RHS=-999899898449/10^12<0. All formulas follow from the actual code C⊕Cperp structure. No numerical tolerance is used. Unproved limit is attainability at distance six.

value.rationale: This is the precise unique reverse joint-versus-Gauss comparison in the recent 2026 study whose numerical conclusion was explicitly left uncertified. An exact reproducible Farkas obstruction changes evidence from a heuristic LP endpoint into a theorem, and rigorously exhibits strict relaxation-strength separation for a motivated benchmark. This is not an arbitrary parameter increment or an automatic reproduction of published certified computations; no claim of an infinite family is made.
